Keeping unwanted guests off your property is the first line of defense in keeping your home safe.

intruders (and you) even when you aren’t around.

warning to leave with your choice of voice and tone.

notifications about what’s important to you.

door and captures it on video- even in the dark.

competitors provides long term value.

Indoor cameras come equipped with two-way audio so you can keep tabs on intruders, kids, pets and
older parents.

Your browser does not support the video tag.

With the Frontpoint app, all of your security needs are in one place. See live and recorded video
footage, arming activity, sensor activity and more.

The equipment for your custom system is preconfigured for you to install on your own schedule. Set
up is a breeze with our set-up wizard and support team ready to help.

Scene” to lock your smart doorlock, turn off lights and arm your system with the click of a button.

Your browser does not support the video tag.

**Control access: **
Smart Door Locks can be programmed with unique and temporary entry codes. Great for giving access to
dog walkers, repair workers, guests and kids.

**Work smarter: **
Lock up without getting locked out. Unlock your Smart Door Lock from the door keypad or while you
are on vacation with the Frontpoint app.

**Don’t get left in the dark: **
Create custom schedules with Frontpoint’s Smart Plugs to save energy and never come home to a dark
house.

**Financing Options**

financing partners. Qualified customers may finance at 0% APR for up to 60 months, with terms
varying by offer. Financing requires a separate agreement with the financing partner. Month-to-month

`Lesson Overview`

## What You Will Master in ACSMI’s Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification

Cybersecurity isn’t just a career path anymore, it’s a frontline battle. With ACSMI’s
[Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification][95]. You learn how to outthink,
outmaneuver, and outlast the next generation of cyber threats.
**Inside 300+ carefully crafted lessons, you’ll master:**

### You won’t just know cybersecurity, you’ll command it.

[icon]

#### Incident Response and Digital Forensics

Lead cyber investigations, recover breached systems, and present bulletproof forensic evidence —
just like top SOCs worldwide.

[Information Security and Data Protection]

#### Information Security and Data Protection

Command identity management, cryptography, and GDPR/CCPA-grade data defense — the skillset every
future-ready organization demands.

[icon]

#### Malware Analysis and Reverse Engineering

Deconstruct malware and protect digital ecosystems from quantum-era cyberweapons.

[icon]

#### Cybersecurity in Specialized Sectors

Dominate critical sector cybersecurity: healthcare, aviation, maritime, smart cities, and more.

[icon]

#### Cloud Security and Virtual Environments

Build resilient cloud infrastructures across AWS, Azure, and hybrid environments — fully compliant,
fully secure

[icon]

#### Ethical Hacking and Penetration Testing

Deconstruct malware and protect digital ecosystems from quantum-era cyberweapons.

[icon]

#### Foundations of Cybersecurity

Build indestructible knowledge in threat landscapes, frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001), and legal/ethical
operations

[icon]

#### Endpoint, Cloud, and Application Security

Fortify endpoints, cloud-native apps, containers, and serverless architectures against relentless
attacks.

[icon]

#### Network Security and Infrastructure Protection

Architect, harden, and defend 5G, cloud, and enterprise networks with firewalls, IDPS, VPNs, and
Zero Trust models.

[icon]

#### Threat Intelligence and Threat Hunting

Detect, isolate, and eradicate advanced threats with real-world APT simulations and machine-learning
enhanced threat hunting.

`why choose us`

## Why Choose ACSMI's Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification?

[tick icon]

**Advanced cybersecurity training** online covering every major certification framework

[tick icon]

**14-Day Refund Guarantee** — enroll risk-free.

[tick icon]

**CPD Accredited Certification** recognized globally.

[tick icon]

**300+ in-depth modules** designed for real-world cybersecurity mastery.

[tick icon]

**Fast-track or self-paced learning** options available.

[tick icon]

Live webinars, 1-on-1 mentorship, and practical labs.

[tick icon]

**Online cybersecurity training** with certificate ready for industry roles.

[tick icon]

**Flexible tuition plans** up to 12 months interest-free

**Learn smarter, certify faster, and stand out with an accredited cybersecurity certification
online**

[ ➔ Enroll in Our Cybersecurity Training Program ][96]

`Career Opportunities`

### ASCMI’s Certification Will Get You Practical Skills That Set You Apart

Hiring managers don’t want memorized facts. They want proven defenders.You’ll graduate with a
portfolio, a toolkit, and the battle scars that prove you’re ready to own a cybersecurity career.
* #### CTF Challenges
  
  Capture the flag scenarios that sharpen real-time hacking and defense instincts.
* #### Capstone Breach Simulation
  
  Architect an enterprise defense, survive a full-scale attack, and prove your strategy in a
  simulated boardroom defense briefing.
* #### SIEM and Threat Hunting Labs
  
  Master tools like Splunk and Elastic for threat detection, response, and proactive hunting.
* #### Penetration Testing Playbooks
  
  Go beyond theory with full-scope penetration testing across cloud, mobile, network, and IoT
  landscapes.
* #### Cloud Security Deployments
  
  Build multi-layered defenses in AWS, Azure, and hybrid clouds with live case studies.

[ ➔ Get Started ][97]

`how it works`

### How to Get Started with ACSMI’s Cybersecurity Certification, Step-by-Step Process

Starting your cybersecurity career with ACSMI’s Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification is
simple and streamlined. Here’s how you can get started:

**ACSMI makes it easier than ever to transition from where you are now — to where cybersecurity’s
future needs you.**
* ## 01. Choose Your Enrollment Option:
  
  Select your preferred plan — full access, mentorship upgrade, or flexible 12-month payments
  starting at just $208/month.
  
  [Choose Your Enrollment Option]
* ## 02. Complete Your Registration
  
  Register securely through our online portal. You'll get instant access to your learning dashboard,
  course materials, and support channels.
  
  [Complete Your Registration]
* ## 03. Attend Orientation and Launch
  
  Start with a welcome session to map your learning path. Whether you choose the 8-week fast-track
  or 3–6 month self-paced option, you’ll have complete guidance from day one.
  
  [Attend Orientation and Launch]
* ## 04. Dive Into Interactive Learning
  
  Begin hands-on labs, CTF challenges, live webinars, and real-world simulations, all while building
  your cybersecurity portfolio.
  
  [Dive Into Interactive Learning]
* ## 05. Complete Certification Exams
  
  Defend a breach simulation, finish your capstone project, and prepare for certifications like
  CISSP, CEH, OSCP, and more
  
  [Complete Certification Exams]
* ## 06. Advance Your Career
  
  Walk away not just with a CPD-accredited certificate, but a battle-tested cybersecurity resume
  employers recognize and trust.
  
  [Advance Your Career]

`What You Will Learn`

## How You’ll Learn: Fast-Track or Flex Through ACSMI’s Cybersecurity Certification

Your life isn’t on pause, and your career ambitions shouldn’t be either. That’s why ACSMI’s Advanced
Cybersecurity & Management Certification gives you complete control over your timeline:

Both tracks deliver **the same powerhouse curriculum**, labs, capstone defense, and certification
preparation, just built around your reality, not someone else's.

[Fast-Track Option]

Fast-Track Option

Complete your full certification in as little as **8 weeks** through an intensive, structured
bootcamp experience, perfect for career changers and go-getters ready to dive in.

[Self-Paced Flexibility]

Self-Paced Flexibility

Need balance? Take **3–6 months** to work through the curriculum around your job, family, or
existing studies, with no deadlines locking you down.

`Who Needs Us`

### Who ACSMI’s Dual Cybersecurity & Management Certification Is Built For

Cybersecurity has no one-size-fits-all, and neither does ACSMI’s Advanced Cybersecurity & Management
Certification. Wherever you're starting, ACSMI doesn’t just prepare you for a cybersecurity job —
**it prepares you to lead the future of security itself.**

[College Graduates]

#### **College Graduates**

Launch your career with leadership-grade credentials and skills that outpace entry-level
competition.

[Career Changers]

#### **Career Changers**

Break into cybersecurity fast with practical, recognized certification and hands-on proof you can
deliver.

[IT Professionals]

#### **IT Professionals**

Specialize and pivot toward six-figure cybersecurity roles, cloud security, ethical hacking, or
threat intelligence.

[Security Analysts]

#### **Security Analysts**

Move up from daily tasks to high-level strategic defense, threat hunting, and leadership roles.

[Aspiring CISOs]

#### **Aspiring CISOs**

Learn governance, budgeting, and security operations leadership to transition into decision-maker
roles.

`who is it for`

### Who Hires Cybersecurity Specialists With ACSMI’s Advanced Cybersecurity & Management
### Certification?

Demand is growing across every vertical that depends on digital operations — and ACSMI-certified
professionals are equipped to lead across them all.

# Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification | ACSMI Online Training

The [Advanced Cybersecurity Management Institute (ACSMI)][90] provides professional cybersecurity
certification and management training online. ACSMI is NOT affiliated with the American College of
Sports Medicine (ACSM) — we are a dedicated cybersecurity education organization focused on
multi-domain security training.

Earn your Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification (ACSMC) through our CPD-accredited and
ACE college credit-recognized program. Whether you're a [career changer][91], IT professional, or
[aspiring CISO][92], this comprehensive cybersecurity training program delivers the skills employers
demand.

This CPD-accredited and ACE college credit recognized online cybersecurity certification is designed
to bridge the gap between theory and real-world skills. Gain new career opportunities with our
professional cybersecurity certification that provides affordable yet high-quality training across
industries and skillsets to preserve lifetime career success and easier career pivots.

`Lesson Overview`

## What You Will Master in ACSMI’s Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification

Cybersecurity isn’t just a career path anymore, it’s a frontline battle. With ACSMI’s
[Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification][95]. You learn how to outthink,
outmaneuver, and outlast the next generation of cyber threats.
**Inside 300+ carefully crafted lessons, you’ll master:**

### You won’t just know cybersecurity, you’ll command it.

[icon]

#### Incident Response and Digital Forensics

Lead cyber investigations, recover breached systems, and present bulletproof forensic evidence —
just like top SOCs worldwide.

[Information Security and Data Protection]

#### Information Security and Data Protection

Command identity management, cryptography, and GDPR/CCPA-grade data defense — the skillset every
future-ready organization demands.

[icon]

#### Malware Analysis and Reverse Engineering

Deconstruct malware and protect digital ecosystems from quantum-era cyberweapons.

[icon]

#### Cybersecurity in Specialized Sectors

Dominate critical sector cybersecurity: healthcare, aviation, maritime, smart cities, and more.

[icon]

#### Cloud Security and Virtual Environments

Build resilient cloud infrastructures across AWS, Azure, and hybrid environments — fully compliant,
fully secure

[icon]

#### Ethical Hacking and Penetration Testing

Deconstruct malware and protect digital ecosystems from quantum-era cyberweapons.

[icon]

#### Foundations of Cybersecurity

Build indestructible knowledge in threat landscapes, frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001), and legal/ethical
operations

[icon]

#### Endpoint, Cloud, and Application Security

Fortify endpoints, cloud-native apps, containers, and serverless architectures against relentless
attacks.

[icon]

#### Network Security and Infrastructure Protection

Architect, harden, and defend 5G, cloud, and enterprise networks with firewalls, IDPS, VPNs, and
Zero Trust models.

[icon]

#### Threat Intelligence and Threat Hunting

Detect, isolate, and eradicate advanced threats with real-world APT simulations and machine-learning
enhanced threat hunting.

## Why Choose ACSMI's Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification?

[tick icon]

**Advanced cybersecurity training** online covering every major certification framework

[tick icon]

**14-Day Refund Guarantee** — enroll risk-free.

[tick icon]

**Learn smarter, certify faster, and stand out with an accredited cybersecurity certification
online**

[ ➔ Enroll in Our Cybersecurity Training Program ][96]

`Career Opportunities`

### ASCMI’s Certification Will Get You Practical Skills That Set You Apart

Hiring managers don’t want memorized facts. They want proven defenders.You’ll graduate with a
portfolio, a toolkit, and the battle scars that prove you’re ready to own a cybersecurity career.
* #### CTF Challenges
  
  Capture the flag scenarios that sharpen real-time hacking and defense instincts.
* #### Capstone Breach Simulation
  
  Architect an enterprise defense, survive a full-scale attack, and prove your strategy in a
  simulated boardroom defense briefing.
* #### SIEM and Threat Hunting Labs
  
  Master tools like Splunk and Elastic for threat detection, response, and proactive hunting.
* #### Penetration Testing Playbooks
  
  Go beyond theory with full-scope penetration testing across cloud, mobile, network, and IoT
  landscapes.
* #### Cloud Security Deployments
  
  Build multi-layered defenses in AWS, Azure, and hybrid clouds with live case studies.

[ ➔ Get Started ][97]

`how it works`

### How to Get Started with ACSMI’s Cybersecurity Certification, Step-by-Step Process

Starting your cybersecurity career with ACSMI’s Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification is
simple and streamlined. Here’s how you can get started:

**ACSMI makes it easier than ever to transition from where you are now — to where cybersecurity’s
future needs you.**
* ## 01. Choose Your Enrollment Option:
  
  Select your preferred plan — full access, mentorship upgrade, or flexible 12-month payments
  starting at just $208/month.
  
  [Choose Your Enrollment Option]
* ## 02. Complete Your Registration
  
  Register securely through our online portal. You'll get instant access to your learning dashboard,
  course materials, and support channels.
  
  [Complete Your Registration]
* ## 03. Attend Orientation and Launch
  
  Start with a welcome session to map your learning path. Whether you choose the 8-week fast-track
  or 3–6 month self-paced option, you’ll have complete guidance from day one.
  
  [Attend Orientation and Launch]
* ## 04. Dive Into Interactive Learning
  
  Begin hands-on labs, CTF challenges, live webinars, and real-world simulations, all while building
  your cybersecurity portfolio.
  
  [Dive Into Interactive Learning]
* ## 05. Complete Certification Exams
  
  Defend a breach simulation, finish your capstone project, and prepare for certifications like
  CISSP, CEH, OSCP, and more
  
  [Complete Certification Exams]
* ## 06. Advance Your Career
  
  Walk away not just with a CPD-accredited certificate, but a battle-tested cybersecurity resume
  employers recognize and trust.
  
  [Advance Your Career]

`What You Will Learn`

## How You’ll Learn: Fast-Track or Flex Through ACSMI’s Cybersecurity Certification

Your life isn’t on pause, and your career ambitions shouldn’t be either. That’s why ACSMI’s Advanced
Cybersecurity & Management Certification gives you complete control over your timeline:

Both tracks deliver **the same powerhouse curriculum**, labs, capstone defense, and certification
preparation, just built around your reality, not someone else's.

[Fast-Track Option]

Fast-Track Option

Complete your full certification in as little as **8 weeks** through an intensive, structured
bootcamp experience, perfect for career changers and go-getters ready to dive in.

[Self-Paced Flexibility]

Self-Paced Flexibility

Need balance? Take **3–6 months** to work through the curriculum around your job, family, or
existing studies, with no deadlines locking you down.

`Who Needs Us`

### Who ACSMI’s Dual Cybersecurity & Management Certification Is Built For

Cybersecurity has no one-size-fits-all, and neither does ACSMI’s Advanced Cybersecurity & Management
Certification. Wherever you're starting, ACSMI doesn’t just prepare you for a cybersecurity job —
**it prepares you to lead the future of security itself.**

[College Graduates]

#### **College Graduates**

Launch your career with leadership-grade credentials and skills that outpace entry-level
competition.

[Career Changers]

#### **Career Changers**

Break into cybersecurity fast with practical, recognized certification and hands-on proof you can
deliver.

[IT Professionals]

#### **IT Professionals**

Specialize and pivot toward six-figure cybersecurity roles, cloud security, ethical hacking, or
threat intelligence.

[Security Analysts]

#### **Security Analysts**

Move up from daily tasks to high-level strategic defense, threat hunting, and leadership roles.

[Aspiring CISOs]

#### **Aspiring CISOs**

Learn governance, budgeting, and security operations leadership to transition into decision-maker
roles.

`who is it for`

### Who Hires Cybersecurity Specialists With ACSMI’s Advanced Cybersecurity & Management
### Certification?

Demand is growing across every vertical that depends on digital operations — and ACSMI-certified
professionals are equipped to lead across them all.

Abby Villanueva

[quote]

Like a smart doorbell & pet monitor in one!

I just LOVE AlfredCamera because it reassures me my babies are safe! I have 6 dogs & they are my big
babies. Problem is they don't get along anymore so they keep their own space. AlfredCamera helps me
relax by letting me check in on them visually & with audio so I know if there's barking, howling,
whimpering. Plus, I can talk to them & get them to calm down with the speaker function (still freaks

pane of glass in the front door so when the camera is flipped to the rear, I can check who comes to

...More

Kamil Gamble

[quote]

I set AlfredCamera up and left for a walk. Within a few minutes I caught the thief on film.

I was living in a domestic violence shelter, with my service dog and child last summer. I noticed
things of mine were going missing. I had used AlfredCamera in the past to watch over my pet if he
were home alone or when my child was napping. I set AlfredCamera up and left for a walk. Within a
few minutes I caught the thief on film. I hate thieves, especially when you are all alone and scared
in an unfamiliar place. I fled my abuser and had almost nothing just like all the other women there.
She was told she had to leave, and from then on there was not another problem.

...More

Blaine Mcguire

[quote]

I have 2 old cell phones set up as AlfredCamera cameras to watch over my baby. It has been a
lifesaver!

Doggy Nanny Cam! My 2 year old Great Dane, Archer, is too big for a cage or kennel. So with the help
of AlfredCamera, I can safely give Archer his own bedroom. I have 2 old cell phones set up as
AlfredCamera cameras to watch over my baby when I am not home. It has been a lifesaver! Literally!
About a year ago, I was able to rush home the moment I found the dog trying to eat a dryer sheet
that must have been stuck to his bedding. I used the speaker feature to tell him to stop chewing on
it and got home before he could swallow anything dangerous! Although.... It does look a little
strange when I am sitting in a restaurant yelling at my phone "BAD DOG....PUT THAT DOWN!" LOL!

...More

Savannah Dennis

[quote]

AlfredCamera has been a huge help for people with epilepsy!

I have had epilepsy for 25 years and most of my seizures occur at night thus I do not know when I
have them all. I have use this to record myself sleeping, and when the motion activation is used it
begins recording when a seizure happens, providing info I can share with my doctors. I have also
mentioned this app to epilepsy groups as a possible aid for others who need help.

...More

[quote]

“AlfredCamera is watching you”

I live it a rural area and there are no street lights at all. There have been several break-ins in
the area lately. I use my AlfredCamera to see who is approaching my house at night. And I put up a
sign warning people that they are on camera. “AlfredCamera is watching you”

...More

Abby Villanueva

[quote]

Like a smart doorbell & pet monitor in one!

I just LOVE AlfredCamera because it reassures me my babies are safe! I have 6 dogs & they are my big
babies. Problem is they don't get along anymore so they keep their own space. AlfredCamera helps me
relax by letting me check in on them visually & with audio so I know if there's barking, howling,
whimpering. Plus, I can talk to them & get them to calm down with the speaker function (still freaks
some out when they hear me but can't find me, lol!) Also, I have it positioned in a small peephole
pane of glass in the front door so when the camera is flipped to the rear, I can check who comes to
my front door! Like a smart doorbell & pet monitor in one!

...More

Kamil Gamble

[quote]

I set AlfredCamera up and left for a walk. Within a few minutes I caught the thief on film.

I was living in a domestic violence shelter, with my service dog and child last summer. I noticed
things of mine were going missing. I had used AlfredCamera in the past to watch over my pet if he
were home alone or when my child was napping. I set AlfredCamera up and left for a walk. Within a
few minutes I caught the thief on film. I hate thieves, especially when you are all alone and scared
in an unfamiliar place. I fled my abuser and had almost nothing just like all the other women there.
She was told she had to leave, and from then on there was not another problem.

...More

Blaine Mcguire

[quote]

I have 2 old cell phones set up as AlfredCamera cameras to watch over my baby. It has been a
lifesaver!

Doggy Nanny Cam! My 2 year old Great Dane, Archer, is too big for a cage or kennel. So with the help
of AlfredCamera, I can safely give Archer his own bedroom. I have 2 old cell phones set up as
AlfredCamera cameras to watch over my baby when I am not home. It has been a lifesaver! Literally!
About a year ago, I was able to rush home the moment I found the dog trying to eat a dryer sheet
that must have been stuck to his bedding. I used the speaker feature to tell him to stop chewing on
it and got home before he could swallow anything dangerous! Although.... It does look a little
strange when I am sitting in a restaurant yelling at my phone "BAD DOG....PUT THAT DOWN!" LOL!

...More

Savannah Dennis

[quote]

AlfredCamera has been a huge help for people with epilepsy!

I have had epilepsy for 25 years and most of my seizures occur at night thus I do not know when I
have them all. I have use this to record myself sleeping, and when the motion activation is used it
begins recording when a seizure happens, providing info I can share with my doctors. I have also
mentioned this app to epilepsy groups as a possible aid for others who need help.

...More

[quote]

when I was out. It is very convenient because you can check the status of your room.

# Whole home coverage starts here

Our smart security cameras let you see, hear, and speak from the Blink Home Monitor app. Experience
HD day and night video, two way audio, motion detection, and more. Get up to two years of battery
life* with our wire-free devices.

Featuring next-level 2K clarity, enhanced audio, plus an easy wireless setup, our next-generation
Outdoor 2K+ gives you complete security for your view, your way. No wires. No worries. No
compromises.

### **New** Outdoor 2K+

[ Learn more ][74]

Mini camera, max performance. Mini 2K+ is our third-generation compact plug-in camera, featuring
sharp 2K video resolution and expansive coverage that captures every detail in stunning clarity.

### **New** Mini 2K+

[ Learn more ][75]

Blink Arc is a compact, weather-resistant mount that connects two Blink Mini 2K+ cameras, delivering
180° panoramic live view with a Blink Plus Plan (sold separately). Two cameras. One power source.
Complete coverage.

### **New** Blink Arc

[ Learn more ][76]

Video Doorbell is our second-generation smart security doorbell with up to two years of battery
life, an expanded field of view, and improved security features for more peace of mind, no matter
where you are.

### Video Doorbell

[ Learn more ][77]

“We were minutes away from losing our memories, our home, and most concerning, our precious dog
babies. Get yourself a camera... changed the course of my life.”

#### — Monica S., Blink Customer

## Blink and you’re home

[Blink Home Monitor App]

### See, hear, and speak from anywhere

The Blink Home Monitor app connects your home to your phone for the ultimate peace of mind. With
multi-system support, you can use Blink to help watch over your home, vacation home, or business all
at the same time. Plus, control multiple Blink systems in one app.

[Learn more][78]
[Alexa-enabled Devices]

### Do more with Alexa

Go hands free with select Alexa-enabled devices! Be alerted when motion is detected, stream live
video, speak to visitors with two-way talk, create helpful routines, and so much more. Features may
vary upon setup and device type.

[Learn more][79]

## Smart security designed for every home

Bring peace of mind home with Blink indoor and outdoor devices

[ Shop now ][80]

*Battery life will vary based on device settings, use, and environmental factors.

cameras, and WiFi), digital video recorders (DVR, NVR, XVR), and CCTV accessories. We cater to
customers of all shapes and sizes, including small and big business, home consumers, State and
Federal Government entities. Customers from around the World choose us as their preferred equipment
provider because of the best security camera buying experience we offer. From the beginning of the

## **Security Starts with Behavior**

A new class of insiders is emerging. AI agents now act alongside human employees, often at machine
speed and massive scale. Traditional security tools were not built to see or understand this
behavior. To keep pace, security teams need a combination of human
insight and digital-speed intelligence to monitor, govern, and secure this evolving workforce while
simultaneously leveraging its power for accelerated security operations. 

[robot]

### ****Address the new class of insider threats created by AI agents****

**100:1** digital workers for every human (Jensen Huang, NVIDIA)

[stats]

[AI]

### ****Use AI agents to tame SOC noise and amplify analyst capacity****

**500%** increase in logs from compromised systems (Tech Radar)

## ****A New Model for Proactive****
## **Threat Detection and Response**

and intelligent agents to accelerate security operations.**

**Security teams gain the speed and precision they need through continuous optimization and

less analyst effort.**

## Human or Not.

**Insider risk is now the #1 security challenge. By applying behavioral analytics to both humans and
AI agents, Exabeam helps organizations detect the subtle signals of compromised credentials,
malicious activity, and misaligned autonomous systems earlier.**

[Download the Guide >][112]

protecting against today’s sophisticated threats and demonstrate value to the business.”**

## **Accelerating Security Operations with Agentic AI**

[AI]

****AI Agent-Powered TDIR****

Automate and accelerate threat detection, investigation and response (TDIR). An integrated team of
AI agents streamlines the entire TDIR workflow, from enriching threat data to building
evidence-backed timelines. Experience faster and more precise investigations, increasing team
productivity.

[target]

****Insider Threat Coverage for Humans and Agents****

Monitor behavior of both employees and AI agents to gain visibility into this new class of insider
threat. User and entity behavior analytics (UEBA) and Agent Behavior Analytics (ABA) automatically
baseline activity, exposing anomalies that signal an actionable threat.

[outcomes]

****Quantifiable, Outcomes-Focused Security****

Benchmark and prove the value of your security program against peers and measurable outcomes.
Translate raw security data into business-relevant insights to demonstrate progress against your
most strategic use cases, MITRE ATT&CK TTPs, and compliance initiatives.

[sign post]

****Unmatched Customer Choice and Flexibility****

Maximize your investment in best-of-breed security tools with an open platform. Gain a unified view
of your security operation without getting locked into a proprietary scheme. Control costs with
advanced data pipeline management that allows you to search data in place and leverage low-cost
storage.

A new class of insiders is emerging. AI agents now act alongside human employees, often at machine
speed and massive scale. Traditional security tools were not built to see or understand this
behavior. To keep pace, security teams need a combination of human
insight and digital-speed intelligence to monitor, govern, and secure this evolving workforce while
simultaneously leveraging its power for accelerated security operations.

## FQAs About CCTV Cameras

JER has been wholesaling CCTV cameras for 15+ years and we have encountered all kinds of problems.
Here are the most important concerns of our customers before closing the deal.

### What is your company specialized in?

We Supply AHD Analog Camera, IP Camera, DVR, NVR, WiFi CCTV System, PoE CCTV System, AHD CCTV
System, Solar Camera, Battery Camera etc.

##### How to select lens for CCTV Camera?

The first specification to consider when choosing a security camera lens is its focal length. The
focal length of a lens determines both the range and distance of its field of vision. The basic rule
to remember is that a smaller focal length will lead to a wider viewable range. Conversely, a larger
focal length will have a more narrow field of vision, but it will also have a farther range. A 2.8mm
lens has a horizontal viewing Angle of about 110°. A 3.6mm lens with a 90° horizontal viewing Angle,
4mm with a 75°horizontal viewing angle, 6mm with a 60°horizontal viewing angle, 12mm with a
25°horizontal viewing angle.

##### How do you ensure product quality and timely delivery?

You deserve the highest-quality contract manufacturing and packaging services every single time.
This is why our industry-leading Quality System extends throughout the supply chain--from product
receipt to final deliver--at every of our facility. This ensures quality products and timely
delivery you can count on.

##### Can I come to China for factory inspection?

Of course, but it is better to wait until the epidemic subsides. Now we support using ZOOM for
online factory inspection. Or you can hire a third-party organization to inspect our factory.

### Can you send free samples?

Unfortunately, no. You will have to pay the samples’ cost and a small fee for shipping. We will
refunded the sample cost when you make a bulk order.

### Which of your products are selling better?

All Products are popular, but not every market is the same. For example, some customers like HD
analog cameras and some customers like IP cameras, so if you are planning to purchase them, it is
best to ask our experienced consultants.

##### Why is your product so cost-effective?

With our mission to help our customers cut down converting costs, we don’t believe in over priced
strategy. We have been striving to do our best to keep price as low as possible without sacrificing
quality, for instance, we improve the competitiveness on manufacturing costs by actively seeking the
best possible component options and manage supply chain logistics. We hope that by giving best
support on price to you, we could help ease your capital pressure and develop a mutually beneficial
business relationship together.

##### Any benefits for CCTV Cameras wholesale from China?

In a word, China has a much better industry chain. There may be wholesalers of CCTV cameras in India
and Vietnam , but JER can guarantee that our prices can be on par with theirs and our service far
exceeds your expectations.

##### What’s your Payment terms?

You can use Western Union, which has a lower fee, or PayPal if you can accept a slightly higher fee,
but please note that for new customers, we only accept the 30% T/T of the payment, or if you have
been with us for years and run into cash flow pressure, we do offer OA credit.

##### What is your guarantee or warranty if we buy your products?

We offer you a 1-3 years warranty on our high-quality products and lifetime technical support and
maintain.

##### What is the delivery time?

It depends on the order quantity and the season you place the order, and also depends on the speed
of customs clearance and logistics. Usually we can ship within 7 days for small quantity, and about
15 days for large quantity order.

##### Do you provide customized service?

Yes, we support OEM and ODM services. We will provide you with expert guidance at the same time,
based on our many years of experience in the industry.

## FQAs About CCTV Cameras

JER has been wholesaling CCTV cameras for 15+ years and we have encountered all kinds of problems.

### What is your company specialized in?

We Supply AHD Analog Camera, IP Camera, DVR, NVR, WiFi CCTV System, PoE CCTV System, AHD CCTV
System, Solar Camera, Battery Camera etc.

##### How to select lens for CCTV Camera?

The first specification to consider when choosing a security camera lens is its focal length. The
focal length of a lens determines both the range and distance of its field of vision. The basic rule
to remember is that a smaller focal length will lead to a wider viewable range. Conversely, a larger
focal length will have a more narrow field of vision, but it will also have a farther range. A 2.8mm
lens has a horizontal viewing Angle of about 110°. A 3.6mm lens with a 90° horizontal viewing Angle,
4mm with a 75°horizontal viewing angle, 6mm with a 60°horizontal viewing angle, 12mm with a
25°horizontal viewing angle.

##### How do you ensure product quality and timely delivery?

You deserve the highest-quality contract manufacturing and packaging services every single time.
This is why our industry-leading Quality System extends throughout the supply chain--from product
receipt to final deliver--at every of our facility. This ensures quality products and timely
delivery you can count on.

##### Can I come to China for factory inspection?

Of course, but it is better to wait until the epidemic subsides. Now we support using ZOOM for
online factory inspection. Or you can hire a third-party organization to inspect our factory.

### Can you send free samples?

Unfortunately, no. You will have to pay the samples’ cost and a small fee for shipping. We will
refunded the sample cost when you make a bulk order.

### Which of your products are selling better?

All Products are popular, but not every market is the same. For example, some customers like HD
analog cameras and some customers like IP cameras, so if you are planning to purchase them, it is
best to ask our experienced consultants.

##### Why is your product so cost-effective?

With our mission to help our customers cut down converting costs, we don’t believe in over priced
strategy. We have been striving to do our best to keep price as low as possible without sacrificing
quality, for instance, we improve the competitiveness on manufacturing costs by actively seeking the
best possible component options and manage supply chain logistics. We hope that by giving best
support on price to you, we could help ease your capital pressure and develop a mutually beneficial
business relationship together.

##### Any benefits for CCTV Cameras wholesale from China?

In a word, China has a much better industry chain. There may be wholesalers of CCTV cameras in India
and Vietnam , but JER can guarantee that our prices can be on par with theirs and our service far
exceeds your expectations.

##### What’s your Payment terms?

You can use Western Union, which has a lower fee, or PayPal if you can accept a slightly higher fee,
but please note that for new customers, we only accept the 30% T/T of the payment, or if you have
been with us for years and run into cash flow pressure, we do offer OA credit.

##### What is your guarantee or warranty if we buy your products?

We offer you a 1-3 years warranty on our high-quality products and lifetime technical support and
maintain.

##### What is the delivery time?

It depends on the order quantity and the season you place the order, and also depends on the speed
of customs clearance and logistics. Usually we can ship within 7 days for small quantity, and about
15 days for large quantity order.

Yes, we support OEM and ODM services. We will provide you with expert guidance at the same time,

Cloud Services
Cyber Security
Data Center Solutions

IMS
What kind of networking and content delivery solutions does Orient Technologies Limited offer?

Orient Technologies Limited offers a range of networking and content delivery network solutions.

What industries do you cater to?

We provide Cloud services to a wide range of industries, including Pharmaceutical, Healthcare, BFSI,
ITeS, Government-PSU and more.

How can a company prepare for cloud to cloud migration?

A company can prepare for cloud to cloud migration by performing a comprehensive inventory of its
current infrastructure, data, and applications, identifying potential compatibility issues or data
migration challenges, selecting a compatible cloud provider, and developing a migration plan that
includes testing and risk management measures

How can a company ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration?

A company can ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration by using encryption and secure
transfer protocols, implementing access controls and user authentication measures, and performing
regular security audits and risk assessments.

How can Orient Technologies Limited help us migrate our existing applications and data to the cloud?

Our team of experts can assist you with the planning, execution, and testing of your migration to
the cloud. We also offer automated tools and services to help you migrate your applications and data
quickly and efficiently.

What sets your cybersecurity solutions apart from competitors?

Full-spectrum Cybersecurity Solutions - From Cybersecurity Awareness, endpoint security to Cloud
Security and everything in between, Proactive threat intelligence, reducing vulnerabilities before
they escalate, Customizable security layers based on your unique business needs, Strategic
consulting through vCISO services, ensuring leadership-driven security frameworks, Cost-effective
scalability, offering enterprise-level security to businesses of all sizes.

What’s the ROI of investing in cybersecurity with Cyber Solutions?

Businesses that invest in proactive cybersecurity measures reduce breach costs by an average of 70%.

What industries benefit the most from your cybersecurity solutions?

Healthcare (PHI - protecting personal health information), Finance (Aligning with regulatory
compliances; safeguarding critical information assets), Retail & E-commerce (preventing data theft
and securing payment systems), Technology (safeguarding intellectual property), SMBs and enterprises
facing evolving digital threats.

How do your solutions ensure compliance with regulations like GDPR, HIPAA, or PCI DSS?

Our solutions are designed with compliance at their core. We offer frameworks and automated tools to
ensure your security practices align with industry regulations, minimizing risk and preventing
costly breaches.

How do you protect remote workforces and endpoints?

Through advanced Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) solutions, we secure devices across remote
environments.

How do I know which cybersecurity service is right for my business?

We offer a cyber risk assessment and an initial consultation to evaluate your current security
posture.

Can your solutions integrate with our existing security infrastructure?

Yes! Our services are designed to integrate seamlessly with your existing technology stack.

and securing payment systems), Technology (safeguarding intellectual property), SMBs and enterprises
facing evolving digital threats.

ensure your security practices align with industry regulations, minimizing risk and preventing

environments.

How do I know which cybersecurity service is right for my business?

We offer a cyber risk assessment and an initial consultation to evaluate your current security

# Preemptive exposure management

Whether you follow CTEM, Zero Trust, or your own framework, RedSeal’s AI-enabled exposure management
platform gives you the clarity and context to reduce risk faster — across
IT (on-prem, cloud, remote workers), OT, and IoT environments.

## Know your hybrid environment better than any adversary.

RedSeal delivers AI-enabled cyber terrain visibility and actionable insights to close security and
compliance gaps across your entire hybrid and remote environment. From hidden assets and
misconfigurations to exploitable attack paths, you’ll know exactly what matters most — and how to
address it.

### Hybrid Environment Modeling

Replace static diagrams and fragmented tools with a living, unified model of your entire environment
— complete, accurate, and continuously updated. See every asset, connection, and control, including
the ones other tools miss.

### Attack Path Analysis

Understand every possible way threats could move through your environment — before they strike.
Strengthen defenses and stop lateral movement by fixing exploitable gaps in advance.

### Risk Prioritization

Focus remediation where it reduces the most risk. RedSeal Risk Radius™ combines exploitability with
business impact to identify the exposures that truly matter — backed by transparent scoring, clear
evidence, and visual workflows that show why they’re prioritized.

### Continuous Compliance

Stay audit-ready every day, not just at audit time. RedSeal automatically validates your environment
against internal policies and standards like NIST, PCI DSS, CMMC, and CIS, with proof-ready reports.

# Preemptive exposure management

Whether you follow CTEM, Zero Trust, or your own framework, RedSeal’s AI-enabled exposure management
platform gives you the clarity and context to reduce risk faster — across
IT (on-prem, cloud, remote workers), OT, and IoT environments.

[ Schedule a Demo ][41]
[ LEARN MORE ABOUT CTEM ][42]

## Know your hybrid environment better than any adversary.

RedSeal delivers AI-enabled cyber terrain visibility and actionable insights to close security and
compliance gaps across your entire hybrid and remote environment. From hidden assets and
misconfigurations to exploitable attack paths, you’ll know exactly what matters most — and how to
address it.

### Hybrid Environment Modeling

Replace static diagrams and fragmented tools with a living, unified model of your entire environment
— complete, accurate, and continuously updated. See every asset, connection, and control, including
the ones other tools miss.

### Attack Path Analysis

Understand every possible way threats could move through your environment — before they strike.
Strengthen defenses and stop lateral movement by fixing exploitable gaps in advance.

### Risk Prioritization

Focus remediation where it reduces the most risk. RedSeal Risk Radius™ combines exploitability with
business impact to identify the exposures that truly matter — backed by transparent scoring, clear
evidence, and visual workflows that show why they’re prioritized.

### Continuous Compliance

Stay audit-ready every day, not just at audit time. RedSeal automatically validates your environment
against internal policies and standards like NIST, PCI DSS, CMMC, and CIS, with proof-ready reports.

RedSeal recognized in inaugural 2025 Gartner^{®} Magic Quadrant for Exposure Assessment Platforms

[ Download Now ][43]

## Preemptive exposure management with RedSeal

Our AI-enabled exposure management platform, powered by its automated workflow engine, gives you
complete visibility into how threats can actually move through your hybrid environment, which
exposures matter most to your business, and proof that your controls are working as intended.

[ Watch the Video ][44]

## Protecting your business.
## Protecting the world.

Trusted by five branches of the US military, the world’s most trusted financial institutions, and
global disruptors.

“We are overwhelmed with data and underwhelmed by information. RedSeal allows us to prioritize with
actionable intelligence and stop playing whack-a-mole.”

Defense Agency
DoD Customer

“We needed a tool that on day one, could map the network and figure out the high-value assets while
finding and prioritizing vulnerabilities.”

Civilian Agency
Manager of the Independent Verification, Validation Assessment and Audit Team

“Through RedSeal, we were able to reduce the time it takes to evaluate our systems for specific
vulnerabilities from one person per month to 15 minutes. Now, we can spend our time on mitigation,
rather than assessment.”

Utility Company Director
NERC-CIP Operations, CyberSecurity

## Put RedSeal to work for you

RedSeal enables everyone involved in cybersecurity to work faster and better, together.

and effectively.

### Execute fixes with precision.

### Stay audit-ready.

### Risk & Compliance

Continuously validate your environment against policies and standards to avoid violations,

### Measure and report with confidence.

### CISOS & EXECUTIVES

Rely on a single, trusted view of your digital environment to measure progress, streamline security

## Decision Over Chaos

Embracing Agentic AI

Security teams are drowning in alerts while attackers move faster than ever. Securonix Unified
Defense SIEM uses an Agentic Mesh of specialized AI agents to help teams decide and act across the
threat lifecycle with speed, context, and control.
* Unified detection and response across data sources
* AI-driven anomaly detection with context
* Pre-built content and playbooks

**
The Result:** Security teams improve response times by up to 60 percent.


[SEE HOW][162]

## Alerts to Action

Evolving to the Agentic SOC

Traditional SIEMs generate volume. Modern security demands outcomes. As threats grow more complex,
teams need systems that reason, prioritize, and guide response in real time.

Powered by an Agentic Mesh, Securonix coordinates AI agents across detection, investigation, and
response to turn signals into guided decisions with human oversight.

With Securonix:
* Reduce alert noise and surface validated risk
* Accelerate investigations with contextual guidance
* Strengthen breach readiness across the environment
* Elevate SOC Analysts from Level 1 to Level 2

[SEE HOW][163]

## Productivity Instead of Noise

The AI SOC Analyst

Sam, the AI SOC Analyst, operates across the Unified Defense platform, analyzing behavior,
understanding context, and recommending actions across detection, investigation, and response.
Always learning. Always accountable. Always human-guided.

With Sam:
* Automated alert triage and prioritization
* Contextual enrichment using identity, behavior, and threat intelligence
* Investigation summaries that eliminate manual pivoting
* Case preparation for escalation and response
* Executive- and board-ready security summaries


[MEET SAM][164]

## Unified Defense SIEM’s Powerful Features

Securonix unifies analytics, threat intelligence, investigation, and response into a single
cloud-native platform designed for scale, precision, and speed. The Agentic Mesh orchestrates these
capabilities as one coordinated system.

## AI changed everything.
## The threat landscape included.

Attackers now use AI to generate code, move at machine speed, and exploit gaps. The old model was
built for a slower era. That era is over.

[Floating translucent dashboard cards on a purple-violet gradient, showing 45%, 465, “Purple AI

0202

## The AI era demands a new advantage. SentinelOne delivers it.

One platform powered by Autonomous Security Intelligence. Built to stop emerging threats at machine
speed and give defenders the upper hand.

The AI-Native Cybersecurity Platform

## Built for Defenders.
## Engineered for Advantage.

Endpoint & Identity SecuritySecuring AICloud SecurityAutonomous SOCGlobal Services

### Protect Every Device. Secure Every Identity.

Autonomously stop supply chain, ransomware, behavioral attacks, and credential misuse with AI-native
endpoint and identity protection unified in a single lightweight agent.
* Stop threats at machine speed with behavioral AI
* Detect and disrupt identity-based attacks in real time
* Real-time, AI-automated response and remediation
* Deploy in SaaS, on-premises, hybrid, and air-gapped environments

Detect, contain, and respond to threats in real time with AI-native protection. AI that does more
than protect your business. It protects the AI your business relies on.

### Less Noise. More Impact from Every Analyst

Purple AI and agentic workflows handle triage, correlation, and routine response so analysts can
focus on higher-value decisions.

Intuitive by Design

### Faster Decisions. Simpler Operations.

A unified experience that brings visibility, investigation, and action together in a single console

The 5G modules SIM8200 series of SIMCom provides users with long-distance data transmission
capability via 5G/4G/3G network. The industrial router based on the 5G modules supports data
transparent transmission with high transmission rate and security, which brings capability of
express 5G networking to the industries like smart transportation, environment monitoring, wireless
surveillance, industrial big data transmission, smart finance, smart grid and smart hydraulic
engineering etc.
[+ Learn more][76]
SIMCom smart metering solutions
SIMCom is deeply engaged in the smart metering industry. The NB-IoT modules represented by SIM7070
series has faster data rate, wider coverage and more accurate positioning capability. It supports
multiple kinds of meters to transit data for power grid, water, gas and heating enterprises so as to
achieve the goals of remote metering, dynamic monitoring and optimal distribution of resources.
[+ Learn more][77]
SIMCom smart surveillance solutions
The 5G-AIOT edge computing terminal adopting SIM8200EA-M2 has powerful video processing capability
and can transmit ultra-high-definition video data at a high rate, making surveillance terminals much
easier to deploy. With a wide security monitoring range, multidimensional monitoring data and faster
remote control, 5G-AIOT edge computing terminal shows powerful capabilities of proactive warning,
prevention and prediction.
[+ Learn more][78]
SIMCom IIoT solutions
Supported by the compact-size 5G module SIM8202G-M2, the industrial gateway is easy to be integrated
in the terminal devices. It supports high-speed and stable data transmission, real-time analysis and
smart processing. The Industrial standard design brings it impressive robustness which enables it to
adapt to different industry scenarios, such as AGV , robotic inspection and so on.
